title: The same Gaussian derivative is bounded and Lipschitz on the closed unit ball
source_anchor: Samplinglib original feature differentiation and transport supplement v1, 2026-10-21; units[1] and its complete formula proof
target_statement: Let E be a finite-dimensional real inner-product normed space with its Borel measurable structure, let γ be its centered standard Gaussian law with identity covariance, and let p be any finite real polynomial. For every ambient weight w and direction v, the actual functions f_w(x)=p(⟨w,x⟩) and d_{w,v}(x)=p′(⟨w,x⟩)⟨v,x⟩ belong to L²(γ). There exist simultaneous membership witnesses and a field of continuous real linear maps D(w):E→L²(γ), with D(w)v=[d_{w,v}], such that the actual feature-class map Φ(w)=[f_w] is fully Fréchet differentiable with derivative D(w) at every ambient w. There also exist strictly positive real constants M₁,M₂ such that ‖D(w)‖op≤M₁ for every ‖w‖≤1 and ‖D(u)−D(w)‖op≤M₂‖u−w‖ whenever both weights lie in the closed unit ball. The constants may depend on p and the ambient space; no dimension-independent rate is asserted. All memberships, derivatives and bounds are produced.
